title: Performance lab
purpose: Explain completed measurements and correctness results to people using the house display.

views.medium: One typical update latency and an overall correctness summary.
views.wide: Typical latency beside correctness, suite count and sample context.
views.fullscreen: Suite selection, median/p95 comparisons, individual sample traces, method and limits.

terms.median: The middle recorded run; a description of the typical sampled experience.
terms.p95: 95% of the recorded runs finished within this value, using the benchmark's documented percentile method.
terms.cold: Initial loading or cache-miss work may be included; consult the specific method.
terms.warm: Relevant code or data was already available; consult the specific method.
terms.correctness: Whether the expected behavior passed its checks; a quick result is useful only when it is correct.

limits: Completed benchmark artifacts are not a continuous live performance score.
Compare models and pipelines only when workload and conditions match.
DOM dispatch, browser paint, physical display presentation and microphone-to-screen time are distinct measurements.
Missing measurements stay missing; synthetic UI fixtures are never published as benchmark results.
